title: feat(fields,plugin-grid): a declared object-ref / recipient-picker widget names what the value references in every list (objectui#12613)
body:
Fixes #12613
Clause-②: yes — corrected from the claim's provisional `no` (claim `6214243680`). Measured on the built `packages/fields/dist/index.d.ts` at `d47fb07`: six new exported names (`UnresolvedReferenceMark`, `objectRefOptionLabel`, `RECIPIENT_RECORD_KINDS`, `RECIPIENT_REGISTRY_KINDS`, `FIELD_RECIPIENT_TYPE`, `recipientCandidateLabel`), and two widened members: `CellRendererProps` gains the optional `dependentValues`, a string-keyed `Record` of `unknown` values (the generic is spelled in words because the body sanitizer drops angle-bracket shapes), and `resolveCellRendererType`'s object arm gains `widget?: string`. `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `dist/index.d.ts` gains only a side-effect import, and its `package.json` `sideEffects` names the new registration module. `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s published closure is unchanged. Stored values and the authored metadata accept set are unchanged.

## What changed

The platform already declares the display intent: `sys_sharing_rule.object_name` is `Field.text({ widget: 'object-ref' })` and `recipient_id` is `Field.text({ widget: 'recipient-picker', dependsOn: ['recipient_type', 'object_name'] })` (objectstack `origin/main` `43567a8fc`). The grid ignored it: `resolveCellRendererType` read only `type` and `format`, so both columns drew through the text cell. The producer is right; the renderer did not read a declared key. So the fix is in the renderer, keyed on the declared `widget`, never on an object or field name.

**`@object-ui/fields`** (the rule)
- `resolveCellRendererType` promotes a textual field that declares `widget: 'object-ref'` or `widget: 'recipient-picker'` to the cell registered under that widget key. Other widgets (`filter-condition`, `position-ref`, …) and non-textual types keep their answer.
- Both keys are registered with the stored text as their default face (the `RECORD_POINTER_CARD_TYPE` arrangement). A host without the label faces therefore draws exactly what it drew before.
- `CellRendererProps.dependentValues` (optional): the row, the cell-side counterpart of the edit widget's `dependentValues`. A call site that passes nothing gets the text it drew before.
- The recipient kind table moves into `widgets/recipientKinds.ts`. It is published with `recipientCandidateLabel`, `objectRefOptionLabel` (the picker's `Label (name)` spelling) and `UnresolvedReferenceMark`, for the host face. The edit widgets keep their own reads inline, exactly as on `main`, and list and store what they did.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`** (new: the label faces)
- It registers the object and recipient faces under the two keys. They load, together with their label directory, lazily into `WidgetRefCellFaces-*.js`, outside the eager closure.
- Object face: icon and label come from the console metadata store's object list (`ensureType('object')`, the same `GET /meta/object` list the picker offers), and the tooltip reads `Label (name)`. The icon is drawn as the console's navigation draws an object's (`LazyIcon`, falling back to the Database glyph).
- Recipient face:
  - Users, teams and business units are named by EXACT id: every id any cell asks for in one tick goes out as one `$in` query per kind (chunked at 100).
  - A recipient past the picker's first 500 candidates is named too.
  - Fields the viewer may not read are dropped (`withoutDeniedFields`), as the lookup picker drops them.
  - Positions come from the metadata store.
  - The `field` kind is read off the shared object's schema.
- A value nothing names (deleted record, renamed object, a refused read) draws the raw stored value, muted, with the shipped unresolved-reference mark. It is never blank.

**`@object-ui/plugin-grid`**
- `resolveGridCellRendering` carries the `widget` hint (`GridCellFieldLike.widget`). Column paths A–C pass it explicitly, and path D and the panel pass the whole field def.
- Every type cell on paths A–D, the link cells and the inline record panel hand the row over as `dependentValues`.
- The inline editor still reads `declaredType`. The grouped-band region objectui#12633 changed is untouched.

**Why app-shell holds the faces:** every `packages/fields` module rides the eager `ui-components` chunk, whatever imports it (`scripts/vite-ineffective-dynamic-imports.ts`). That chunk's per-chunk ceiling refused round 0's label reader: 289,748 / 289,000 gzip bytes measured on round 0's head. `main` alone sat at 288,585 at `8ed7e5a`.

## Premise measurements (dispatch §2)
1. Confirmed: both widget hints and the `recipient_type` / `access_level` selects are on `sys_sharing_rule`, and the four `listViews` name the columns as strings (path B).
2. Confirmed on `origin/main` by ablation: with the widget promotion disabled, the promotion cases go red (below).
3. The Studio Access pillar's naming is not a shared helper: its explain report arrives already named from `/api/v1/security/explain`. The faces reuse the edit widgets' kind table and spellings instead.
4. `access_level` already draws as a chip: `SelectCellRenderer` draws a Badge per option label. The platform declares no option colour, and the permission matrix's tones are private functions inside `PermissionMatrixEditor`, so no generic cell is coupled to them.
5. Implemented as stated.

## Card targets
- 1 Object column: icon, label, and the api name in the tooltip — done.
- 2 Recipient label — done for all kinds. The type chip before it ("Position · …") is an accepted deviation. Every list view that shows `recipient_id` also shows the `recipient_type` column beside it, and the chip's text is that sibling select's translated option label, which a cell does not hold.
- 3 Access level chip — already a chip; the tokens are an accepted deviation (above).

## Tests
- Acceptance cases: `packages/app-shell/src/views/widget-ref-cells/__tests__/WidgetRefCellFaces-12613.test.tsx`.
  - `sales_manager` renders "Sales Manager".
  - The object renders its icon and "Account", with tooltip "Account (crm_account)".
  - A recipient past the first 500 candidates is named by exact id, in exactly one `$in` query per kind.
  - A denied name field is left out of the label.
  - An unknown id reads muted.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/widgetHintedColumns-12613.test.tsx` pins the widget key and the row on paths A–D with probe faces.
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/widgetRefCells-12613.test.tsx` pins the promotion, the default faces and the published spellings.
- Round 2 on `d47fb07`: the targeted 21 files → `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 572 passed (572)`. Ablations on the committed head (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - record reads put back on the candidate query → 2 red (exact id, and the policy case past the first page);
  - icon dropped → 1 red;
  - `withoutDeniedFields` removed → 1 red.
- Round 0 ran the full `packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-grid/` and `packages/plugin-detail/` suites (751 files, 8776 tests green). Round 1 ablations: promotion guard disabled → 7 red across the three files; the `recipient-picker` registration deleted → 2 red.
- Censuses: `object-ref` / `recipient-picker` are classified in `cellRenderers.objectLiteral-8596` and in `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` (whose fit-side count moves 36 → 38).

## Gates (local subset, on `d47fb07`)
`turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` 0 · `fields` / `app-shell` / `plugin-grid` type-check 0 · `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` 0 · `node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` 0 · `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` 0 · `check-side-effects-array` 0 · `check-phantom-dependencies` 0 · eslint on the changed files: 0 errors · `check-changeset-presence` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 new · governed-queue guard NOT GOVERNED · control-byte scan: none.

**Merge round, head `f667f86`** (merges `origin/main` `f78efdd`; report `6216423846`): one conflict, in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` against objectui#12608. The same seven cell closures changed on both sides. Each keeps main's `pointerFace?.(row) ??` first, and this branch's `dependentValues={row}` on the fallback renderer element. The 21 targeted files plus `ObjectGrid.recordPointerCell-12608` → `Test Files 22 passed (22)`, `Tests 575 passed (575)`. The package build, the three type-checks, the console build and `check-eager-closure-budget` exit 0. `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check-side-effects-array`, eslint on the resolved file, `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations` exit 0.

**Bundle (on `f667f86`):** `ui-components` 288,876 / 289,000 gzip bytes; eager closure 3118.4 KB of 3119.4 KB. `main`'s v18 dependency bump took most of the aggregate. On `d47fb07` the closure was 3096.6 KB. The faces chunk is lazy. No ceiling, budget file, allow-list or chunk group was touched.

Browser check (1280 px): run by the seat on `d47fb07`. The readings are in the seat's ACCEPT on this PR.

## Surface notes
- `@object-ui/app-shell` was added on the dev's measurement (corrected claim `6214243680`): `src/views/widget-ref-cells/**`, `src/index.ts` (the side-effect import) and `package.json` `sideEffects`. The changeset lists `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`.
- Also outside the first surface, both forced by the change: two census rows (plus the fit-side count) in `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464.test.tsx`, and the `@object-ui/fields` README cell-resolution example (AGENTS.md #2).

## Acceptance notes (not done here; carrier: none)
- `DetailSection` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) resolves `object_name` to the object face but passes no row, so a record page's `recipient_id` still reads as text. Passing `dependentValues={data}` there is one line.
- The By Object view's group band prints the object api name: band labels are strings built in the grid's grouping, not cells.
- Kanban and gallery cards resolve the same way: the object is named, and the recipient reads as text (no row handed over).
- `@objectstack/spec`'s `widget` description says "Form widget override"; list cells now read it for these two hints too.
- On `f667f86`, `ui-components` has 124 gzip bytes of headroom, and the eager closure as a whole has 1.0 KB (`vendor-objectstack` 0.0 KB). The next page-load change of any size may trip one of them. The ceiling change is objectui#12653's (in flight, another seat); nothing was raised here.
